selected_operational_rule.description: H3 Resolution 8 cells with >= 10 observed historical pickups in June 2022 (provisional operational choice; pending forecasting evaluation).

zero_observation_handling_strategy.monthly_totals_vs_window_completeness: Monthly trip counts alone cannot establish window-level zero percentages without window completeness aggregation. Zero-filling is deferred until complete 15-minute streaming/batch windows are established against zone_universe.
zero_observation_handling_strategy.in_demand_windows: Absent zone-windows are NOT treated as zeroes. Finalized windows write only observed demand (ride_count > 0).
zero_observation_handling_strategy.in_forecasting_and_features: Downstream feature pipelines zero-fill ONLY against operational zones in zone_universe, and ONLY for complete 15-minute windows.
zero_observation_handling_strategy.in_dashboard_and_apis: If an operational zone has 0 observed rides in a complete window, observed_rides = 0. If D=0 and C=0, estimated pressure index is 0.0 with status NORMAL (Rule 3). Incomplete windows remain null.

temporal_leakage_assessment.is_operational_universe_warning: The is_operational_universe column in zone_universe.parquet reflects full-month June 2022 retrospective status. It must NOT be treated as leakage-safe eligibility for chronological forecasting evaluation. Phase 3 must derive training-window eligibility independently.
temporal_leakage_assessment.retrospective_scope: Full-month June 2022 operational qualification is retrospective and descriptive. Catalog existence does not imply evaluation-safe operational eligibility.

dataset_interval_utc.note: Half-open [start, end). Start = 2022-06-01 00:00:00 CDT. End = 2022-07-01 00:00:00 CDT.

leakage_sensitivity_demonstration.finding: Zones that qualify under >=10 threshold only because test-period trips are included represent temporal lookahead. Full-month is_operational_universe must not be used as evaluation eligibility.

temporal_leakage_assessment.phase3_leakage_safe_rule: In Phase 3 forecasting, operational zone eligibility must be determined strictly on the training partition (t < T_split), never using future test data.

phase3_downstream_handling_policy.zones_in_training_eligibility: Included in zero-filling, forecasting model training, and evaluation for that split.
phase3_downstream_handling_policy.zones_absent_from_training_eligibility: Excluded from zero-filling and model evaluation for that split. Predictions are not generated. Dashboard shows NON_OPERATIONAL or omits them from the forecasting grid.
phase3_downstream_handling_policy.catalog_preservation: All 239 observed cells remain in zone_universe.parquet as a historical reference catalog regardless of split-specific eligibility.

unresolved_limitations: Centroid Truncation: All source coordinates are anonymized by the City of Chicago to census tract or community centroids (317 unique coordinates). Hexagon boundaries reflect centroid groupings rather than true street-corner hail coordinates.
Single-Month Seasonality: June 2022 represents summer tourism and warm weather travel. Low-volume peripheral zones may exhibit different demand during winter months or bad weather events.
Threshold Provisional: The 10-trip threshold remains provisional until chronological forecasting backtests evaluate alternatives.
